operation.summary: Claim another Bridgit's link code: this Bridgit then uses it (its user opt-in), and may offer the other direction too; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: name
body.description: The other Bridgit's Device Domain Name (required unless link is given)

body.name: code
body.description: Its link code, K7QX-3MPA (required unless link is given)

body.name: link
body.description: Its bridgit://link#… link (holds name, code and its Tailscale address)

body.name: host
body.description: Its Tailscale address, when the names backend can't resolve the name

body.name: agents
body.description: This Bridgit's control agent ids that may use it; default: the calling agent

body.name: reverse_services
body.description: What the other Bridgit may use here in return (it opts in on its side); default none. Limited by the tier

body.name: tier
body.description: This Bridgit's tier for the link (default: the one the code was made with); the narrower of the two applies

operation.returns: the new link (id, name, bridgit_name, target, sat_id, role, tier (own|associate|public: the narrower of tier_here and tier_there), tier_here, tier_there, tier_about, associate, associate_email, expires_at, review_at, registration{id, tier, role host|peer, state, error} (the team backend's record), in{state, services, granter, paused, revoked, other_side}, out{state, agents[{id,name}], granter, paused, revoked, services, other_side}, disconnecting{direction, undo_until})

code.description: Its link code, K7QX-3MPA (required unless link is given)

tier.description: This Bridgit's tier for the link (default: the one the code was made with); the narrower of the two applies

reverse_services.description: What the other Bridgit may use here in return (it opts in on its side); default none. Limited by the tier

name.description: The other Bridgit's Device Domain Name (required unless link is given)

link.description: Its bridgit://link#… link (holds name, code and its Tailscale address)

host.description: Its Tailscale address, when the names backend can't resolve the name

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

agents.description: This Bridgit's control agent ids that may use it; default: the calling agent
